retentions.title: Performance retentions
retentions.intro: Money held back from service invoices. Release it from its due date; once released it waits for a payment run
retentions.releaseBody: The retention of invoice {number} from {supplier} becomes "Releasable" and waits for the next payment run
retentions.released: Released. It waits for a payment run

empty.IN_PAYMENT_RUN: No retentions in a payment run

retentions.emptyHint: A retention starts when a service invoice with retention is ready for payment. See the invoices page

wht.title: Withholding tax
wht.intro: Withholding tax certificates (50 Tawi) issued at payment, and the monthly PND3 and PND53 summaries
wht.downloadFailed: The file could not be opened. Try again
wht.emptyHint: A 50 Tawi is issued when a supplier with tax withheld is paid in a payment run

export.title: Monthly summary
export.hint: Make the PND3 or PND53 summary of a month paid. It is not the Revenue Department filing format; use it to check with your accountant
export.includeIdsHint: The file holds individual payees' full national IDs, and every certificate in it is logged

types.confirmBody: You checked the rate with the accountant. Invoices of this type will be taxed at this rate
types.emptyHint: Add an income type with its rate, then ask another finance member to confirm it
